name: io.github.soma-intelligence/open-health-sync
title: Open Health Sync
description: Read-only access to self-hosted health data: samples, sleep, workouts, nutrition, daily summaries.

environmentVariables.name: OHS_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Open Health Sync instance. Must be https unless the host is loopback (inside a container, loopback is the container itself).

environmentVariables.name: OHS_MCP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A user token with the read scope (ohs_ut_...) or a tenant API key (ohs_sk_...).
